summary: Iteration 42: Comprehensive testing of Self-Service Signup Flow with email verification and 7-day trial period. 21/21 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI tests verified signup wizard, verify-email page, login page with trial link, and navigation flows.

SU-01_register_success.notes: Creates user + tenant + returns success with trial_days=7

SU-04_reserved_subdomain.notes: www, api, admin, demo, test all return 422

VE-03_verify_success.notes: Valid token activates user + tenant, returns tenant_id

LT-01_existing_tenant_no_trial.notes: Demo tenant login returns NO trial_info

LT-02_unverified_user_blocked.notes: Unverified user blocked at middleware (tenant inactive)

LT-04_trial_info_returned.notes: Trial tenant login returns trial_info with days_remaining, is_trial_active

FE-01_signup_page_loads.notes: 2-step wizard renders with Account + Workspace steps

FE-02_signup_step1_fields.notes: Company, email, password, confirm password fields visible

FE-03_signup_step2_fields.notes: Subdomain input with availability check visible

FE-04_signup_navigation.notes: Continue/Back buttons work, step indicators update

FE-05_verify_email_page.notes: Shows error state without token, has navigation links

FE-06_login_trial_link.notes: 'Start your 7-day free trial' link visible on login page

FE-07_login_to_signup_nav.notes: Navigation from login to signup works

FE-08_signup_to_login_nav.notes: Navigation from signup to login works

FE-09_demo_tenant_no_banner.notes: Demo tenant login shows NO trial banner (correct)

FE-10_trial_banner.notes: Trial banner shows after onboarding complete; new tenants see onboarding wizard first

critical_code_review_comments: Signup routes correctly bypass tenant middleware (PUBLIC_PATHS in tenant_middleware.py)
Password validation enforces min 8 chars + letter + number via Pydantic validators
Reserved subdomains (www, api, admin, demo, test) correctly blocked
Email verification flow: token stored in MongoDB, 24-hour expiry, activates user + tenant
Rate limiting on resend-verification: 60-second cooldown enforced
Trial info (days_remaining, is_trial_active) returned only for trial tenants
Existing tenants (demo, acme_corp) return NO trial_info on login
SMTP email service has mock mode when credentials missing (logs instead of sending)

success_rate.frontend: 96% - 24/25 tests passed (1 partial due to onboarding flow)

seed_data_creation: Test users created and cleaned up during tests. Demo tenant preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Self-service signup flow fully tested and working. Key flows: 1) POST /api/signup/register creates user+tenant with pending_verification status, 2) POST /api/signup/verify-email activates both, 3) Login returns trial_info for trial tenants. Trial banner shows in main dashboard after onboarding is complete. New trial tenants see onboarding wizard first.

mocked_api.notes: SMTP email service may use mock mode if Hostinger rate limits are hit (454 error). Emails are logged instead of sent in mock mode.

verified_behaviors: Creates user_tenants mapping with role=admin, is_active=false
Sends verification email via SMTP (or logs in mock mode)
Returns success with tenant_id, subdomain, trial_days=7
Validates token exists and not expired
Blocks expired trials after 3-day grace period (403)
Returns NO trial_info for non-trial tenants
Success state shows 'Check your email' message
Shows for trial tenants after onboarding
